description: Two-Stage Verifier (Stage 2) v2. Adds explicit size criterion for spot heights and colour exclusion for water features.

_config_notes.source: v2 of adversarial verifier. Based on QGIS sanity check (2026-04-08) which identified spot heights (29 FPs) and water features (3 FPs) as the main addressable FP categories.
_config_notes.changes_from_v1: Added spot height size criterion (~5-7px vs >=12px mounds) and water feature colour exclusion (blue = never a mound) to confusable list.
_config_notes.thinking_level: Fixed at minimal — unchanged from v1.
